name: python-leases-fences
title: Leases with fencing tokens
blurb: A lease is a deadline, and a deadline cannot stop a holder that was paused past it. This stack builds both halves: a store that grants one lease at a time with a strictly increasing token, renews from now (never from the old expiry, which would pay a paused holder for time it never used), and treats its own clock as the only authority; and a fenced resource that refuses any write from a token older than the last one it accepted. The same pause is run twice, against a fenced and an unfenced value, so the lost update is printed instead of described.
default_description: A lease with a strictly increasing fencing token, and a resource that refuses the ghost of an expired holder.
